resources.string: On: widgets and notifications are refreshed in the background as soon as the network is back, even with the app closed.
Off: with the app open, the dashboard still refreshes on its own when the network returns. Widgets wait for the next scheduled refresh.
Refresh in the background when the network returns?

When a refresh fails for lack of network, TokenUsage will ask Android to run it again in the background as soon as the connection returns, even if the app is closed, to update widgets and notifications.

• No new permission is requested.
• One refresh per network return, with up to 3 retries if the connection is not usable yet.
• Android decides the exact moment (battery saver, Doze).
• You can turn this off at any time here.
